sanskrit_verse:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानामेष धर्म्यो धनागमः।
विपर्ययादधर्म्यः स्यान्न चेदापद्गरीयसी॥
transliteration: sarveṣām eva varṇānām eṣa dharmyo dhanāgamaḥ | viparyayād adharmyaḥ syān na ced āpad garīyasī ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The acquisition of wealth through righteous means is dharmic for all varnas; when acquired contrary to dharma, it becomes adharmic, unless necessity or existential threat overrides.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with dharma, not social position
Causation arises from intention and method of acquisition
Capacity-based responsibility requires adherence to dharmic frameworks
Restoration logic demands return of ill-gotten gains without punitive overlay
Consciousness alignment determines the legitimacy of material possession
executable_legal_axioms: IF wealth acquired ≠ aligned with declared dharmic framework THEN flag as adharmic possession
IF acquisition under existential threat EXISTS AND necessity proven THEN override standard dharmic evaluation
IF misaligned possession IDENTIFIED THEN initiate automatic restitution protocol
IF actor demonstrates conscious realignment THEN permit lawful retention post-restoration
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies in proving intent and alignment with dharma. Wealth acquired under duress may be exempted conditionally. Authority rests in verifying dharmic consistency, not punitive judgment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dharmic acquisition aligns with cosmic order. Adharmic acquisition disrupts sequential harmony (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility is proportional to awareness. The law does not punish but restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset tracing and return mechanism upon identification of adharmic gain
Assign corrective dharmic action to the possessor until alignment is restored
Engage community oversight to ensure transparent realignment process
Verify completion of restitution through witness affirmation and svadhyaya documentation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Wealth must flow in alignment with consciousness. All possessions misaligned with dharma shall be restored. There is no punishment—only realignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
